newsitem.title: USA: General Scanning unit earns profit.
newsitem.headline: General Scanning unit earns profit.

text.p: General Scanning Inc said Wednesday View Engineering Inc, a recently acquired subsidiary, earned an operating profit on revenues of $7.8 million during its fourth quarter.
The company said the results for the Simi Valley, California subsidiary compared to operating losses for each of the prior three quarters in 1996.
It said the results were subject to its year-end audit.
General acquired the subsidiary in exchange for about 1.4 million shares in its common stock in August 1996.
View Engineering makes measurement and inspection systems.
